hypothesis: A positive weekly change in point-in-time-available S&P 500 Consolidated Leveraged Money net-long share can identify frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events that are too early, improving return while matching or exceeding V11 Sharpe and beating an availability-matched unconditional U.S.-retention control.
allowed_changes: F-COT-LEV-SPX exact weekly change in S&P 500 Consolidated Leveraged Money net-long share of total open interest versus the immediately previous point-in-time usable report
on factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events, retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions when risk-on
selection_metric: No within-family model selection. There is exactly one candidate; compare it against frozen V11 and C-COT-LEV-ALWAYS, then apply the preregistered deterministic, bootstrap and cumulative DSR gates.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260821
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one candidate and no within-family selection
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using the prior 25 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-COT-LEV-SPX, total trial count 26
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This COT campaign contains exactly one retrospective candidate. After any formal performance is viewed, do not search another trader category, Nasdaq confirmation, a multi-week positioning window, z-score/percentile/magnitude threshold, sign reversal, retention fraction, stale rule, availability policy, or a second retrospective COT family. A promising non-robust result may only become a new prospective shadow from a new freeze date.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_cot_leveraged_money_spx_v1.py -> tools/cot_leveraged_money_spx_v1.swiftpart + tools/cot_leveraged_money_spx_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
source/U.S.-de-risk/available/retained event counts and portfolio constraints
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.source: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures, Futures Only
factor_definition.delta_rule: current net share minus immediately previous point-in-time usable report net share

availability_policy.2025_shutdown_backlog: exact official CFTC actual publication dates, usable from actual release date +1 calendar day
availability_policy.historical_report_date_warning: CFTC historical archive dates are position/report dates, not public release timestamps

matched_control.rule: retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions on every factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-de-risk event regardless of the sign of DeltaLevNetShare

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
shared_rules.eligible_event: current frozen V11 event reduces nasdaq and/or sp500 versus the prior frozen V11 event target

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any Asset Manager, Dealer, Other Reportable or Nonreportable rescue candidate
any Nasdaq confirmation, S&P/Nasdaq average or trader-category ensemble
any z-score, percentile, level threshold, magnitude threshold, persistence rule or sign reversal
any change to the 14-day stale rule or frozen CFTC availability policy
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or a second retrospective COT factor after results
changing fee/slippage, leverage, financing, shorting or cash constraints
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting
